name: Open Duck Mini v2: deployable safety envelope

status_legend.verified: read from a file in this repo (named in source)
status_legend.measured: measured on the real duck or its servos (file named)
status_legend.derived: computed from verified/measured numbers (how, in note)
status_legend.proposed: a rule we propose; not yet tested on the robot
status_legend.unverified: manufacturer figure or assumption; nobody has checked it on this duck

actuator_model_version.source: class sts3215 in the training XML; the older fit in joints_properties.xml is 0.60/0.052/0.028/17.8/3.35

total_mass_kg.note: the real duck is estimated at 1.5-1.8 kg (sim/report1); mass is the biggest known model error -> weigh_me.md

deploy_limit_nm.source: 19 kg.cm rated stall at 7.4 V (README: 'STS3215 7.4 V (19 kg.cm)') x 0.0981 = 1.864; used by eval_policy.py, curriculum TORQUE_RANGE, HR_TORQUE
deploy_limit_nm.note: every score and every held test since report 1 ran at this ceiling; a skill passes its battery at this value or it does not ship

model_limit_nm.source: forcerange in the training XML (BAM fit)
model_limit_nm.note: why not 3.23: it is the fit's saturation of kp*error on a bench supply, not a sustained torque; the manufacturer rates 1.9 N.m at 7.4 V; on a 2S pack shared by 14 servos the supply sags; the current brain walks forward at 0.13 m/s in sim at 3.35 but 0.10 at 1.86 and the real duck is nearer the latter (report 1 torque.png). Train at 3.23 and the policy learns to lean on torque the duck does not have

bench_demonstrated_nm.source: strength_data/strength_14_20261014-034321.csv (right ankle on a scale, 15 deg press, still rising at 21 % load)
bench_demonstrated_nm.note: the maximum was not reached; so the real ceiling is > 1.16 and the 1.86 figure is unverified above that

stiffness_nm_per_rad.source: report 1: 0.44 N.m/deg real vs 0.30 sim (x1.48); sim/make_strength_plot.py

training_randomisation.value: TORQUE_RANGE U(1.6, 2.1) N.m per joint when set; KP_RANGE U(1.1, 1.8)

max_motor_velocity_rad_s.source: MAX_MOTOR_VEL=4.0 in sim/curriculum.sh and report 2 'deploy with ... max motor velocity 4 rad/s'; joystick.py clips the target step to max_motor_velocity*dt
max_motor_velocity_rad_s.note: the runtime default is 5.24 rad/s (v2_rl_walk_mujoco.py, duck_config 'max_motor_velocity_rad_s': 5.24); set 4.0 at deploy

runtime_default_rad_s.source: sim/upstream_runtime/scripts/v2_rl_walk_mujoco.py; Pi config snapshot in walk_recordings/meta_walk9.pkl has velocity_clip true

real_walk_joint_speed_rad_s.source: walk_recordings/obs_walk7.pkl dof_vel (knees are the fastest), 155 s of walking on 2026-10-14

model_ceiling_at_deploy_torque_rad_s.source: (1.86 - 0.068) / 0.56 from the XML's forcerange cap, frictionloss and damping (mechatronics/response/response.json velocity_ceiling)
model_ceiling_at_deploy_torque_rad_s.note: lower than the 3.8-4.5 rad/s the real knees reach: capping forcerange alone makes the model slower than the duck at speed. The bench no-load speed test settles it

datasheet_no_load_rad_s.source: Feetech listing 0.222 s/60 deg at 7.4 V (no document on disk)

setting_hz.source: ACT_LPF_HZ=8 in curriculum.sh; runtime --cutoff_frequency 8 (LowPassActionFilter in mini_bdx_runtime/rl_utils.py)

action_filter.formula: alpha = (1/fc) / (1/50 + 1/fc) = 0.862; y = alpha*y + (1-alpha)*x at 50 Hz (same in joystick.py and sim_test.py)

effective_minus3db_hz.source: mechatronics/servo_response_sim.py sweep through the deploy chain; also 50/(2*pi) * -ln(0.862) = 1.18 Hz
effective_minus3db_hz.note: the '8 Hz' setting is a 1.2 Hz first-order filter: the formula uses 1/fc where an RC constant belongs. Sim and runtime share the formula, so training and the duck agree; name the package envelope by the real cutoff

policy_hz.source: control_freq in v2_rl_walk_mujoco.py; measured loop 8 ms mean / 9.7 ms p95 (meta_walk9.pkl tick)

servo_p_gain.source: v2_rl_walk_mujoco.py pid=[30,0,0], kps[5:9]=8; setup_all_servos.py writes P=32 I=0 D=0

action_scale_rad.source: runtime action_scale; LEG_ACTION_SCALE=0.5 brains need the matching runtime value (memory note)

tilt_deg.source: sim_test.py run(): fell = tilt_max > 45 (angle between body z and world z); eval_policy.py uses the same
tilt_deg.note: framework 3.3 says 0.8 rad (45.8 deg) orientation error; training itself only terminates at upvector z < 0 (90 deg)

stability_governor.note: a command scaler, not a fall rule; off

min_base_height_m.source: 60 % of the standing base height; below the chin-up tuck (0.11 m) so a deliberate sit does not count as a fall
min_base_height_m.note: frame: base body z with the floor at 0, the number sim_test.base_pose() returns. Standing 0.15 m (scene keyframe 'home'), IMU 0.20 m, CoM 0.19 m, head 0.39 m; tuck chin_up base 0.11 m, head_down 0.12 m (make_envelope.py / MuJoCo FK)

servo_max_temperature_register_c.source: STS3215 memory table default for EEPROM 0x0D; read it with servo_health.py (Pi unreachable 2026-10-23)

measured_rest_c.source: strength_data CSVs (14 Oct, servos idle-holding, room temperature)
measured_rest_c.note: no reading under walking yet; the telemetry pull supplies it

proposed_rule.rule: max over 14 servos, read at least every 20 s. >= 50: banner, no new episodic skill starts. >= 60: finish the current skill (timeout applies), go to idle, then sit-down abort and servo P to 2 (hold, no stiffness); stay until every servo <= 45. >= 65 or any 'temperature' status flag: motors off via the sit-down path immediately. Log every crossing to the experiment log.
proposed_rule.why: 70 C is where the servo unloads itself (default unloading condition bit 2); 65 leaves 5 C for the sampling gap; the Olaf character robot feeds temperature to its policy and our risk table (framework 5.5) names thermal drift

nominal_v.source: 2S Li-ion pack: 2 x Molicel 18650 (tracker/data/catalog.json), 7.4 V servo version (README)

full_charge_v.source: 4.2 V/cell, BMS listed as 7.4 V/8.4 V 20 A (archive print_vs_buy.csv)

observed_after_charge_v.source: puppet agent / duck_agent.py state on 2026-10-22: every servo reports 8.3 V with the 'voltage' status flag

strength_test_v.source: strength_data CSVs volt column, 14 Oct (sagging to 7.23 V at 183 mA on one servo while holding)

servo_max_voltage_register_v.source: EEPROM 0x0E; Feetech default 80 (0.1 V units) for the 7.4 V STS3215 per the memory table; servo_ping.py reads it as 'voltage limits'; NOT read yet on this duck

battery_guard.source: duck_battery/battery_guard.py DEFAULTS and the Pi config snapshot

operating_range_v.source: battery guard critical to full charge

verdict_8p3.most_likely: 8.3 V > 8.0 V max-voltage register, so the flag is correct and expected on a fresh charge, clears by itself once the pack is below 8.0 V (first minutes of use).
verdict_8p3.consequence: harmless unless bit 0 of the unloading condition (0x13, default 44 = 0b101100: temperature, current, overload) is set; by default a voltage alarm only lights the LED (0x14 default 47 includes it). servo_health.py reports unload_on_voltage per servo.
options_for_the_user: raise 0x0E to 85-90 on all 14 servos: a one-time EEPROM write the user must authorise and do with the bus free; the servos already run at 8.3 V

servo_protection_current_register_a.source: EEPROM 0x1C default 500 x 6.5 mA; read with servo_health.py

pi_supply.value: 5 V from the pack through a regulator; under-voltage flags logged by duck_battery/power_watch.py

proposed.why: peak = the bench abort; pack numbers leave 25 % under the BMS rating; sustained numbers are guesses until the wave_power_test.py log (power_log.csv, not on disk) or a walking telemetry series exists

joint_rules.deploy_range: MJCF range ∩ measured stops (joint_limits/real_limits_20261014.json, joint_limits_probe.py by hand on 2026-10-14), minus 3 deg each side, clipped by the runtime soft limits
joint_rules.clip_checker: a clip whose joint targets leave deploy_range_rad, or whose target rate exceeds max_velocity_rad_s, fails stage 2
joint_rules.suspect: left_hip_pitch measured stop -2.45 rad (-140 deg) is probably the leg folding past the probe (report 1); the intersection with the MJCF makes it harmless

servo_response_model.bench_tolerance: see bench_procedure.md: rise time within 25 %, overshoot within 5 points, -3 dB within 20 %
